attchmntText: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: KPI Green Energy Limited submitted the audio recording of the analyst and investor earnings conference call held on November 13, 2026, at 04:30 P.M. The call discussed the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the Company's website. The transcript will be submitted in due course. This submission complies with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The communication was sent to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. Krunal Bhatt, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the letter.

attchmntText: KPI Green Energy Limited has submitted to the exchange Monitoring Agency report for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: KPI Green Energy Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report dated November 12, 2026, issued by India Ratings & Research Private Limited, to the BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The report covers the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds raised through the preferential issue of warrants. The information is available on the company website at www.kpigreenenergy.com.

attchmntText: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: KPI Green Energy Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 revenue of Rs. 1,451 Cr, EBITDA of Rs. 545 Cr, and PAT of Rs. 187 Cr. Total capacity stands at 8.33 GW, with 5.31 GW installed. Key updates include securing a Rs. 2,025 Cr EPC order for 550 MWp from NACOF Oorja and a PPA with SJVN for 300 MWp wind. The company signed a binding offer to acquire Alfanar Energy and Netra Wind for approximately Rs. 2,410 Cr, adding 507.9 MW of operational wind assets. It also acquired DEK and Mavericks Green Energy through subsidiary Sun Drops Energia. The BESS portfolio is now 565 MW / 1,130 MWh, fully contracted.

attchmntText: KPI Green Energy Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: KPI Green Energy Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 72,721.32 lacs. Profit before tax for the same period was Rs. 13,053.07 lacs. Profit for the period was Rs. 9,194.21 lacs. Basic earnings per share was Rs. 4.17. Diluted earnings per share was Rs. 4.15. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue from operations was Rs. 1,42,105.33 lacs. Profit before tax was Rs. 26,140.07 lacs. Profit for the period was Rs. 18,657.51 lacs. Basic earnings per share was Rs. 8.50. Diluted earnings per share was Rs. 8.47. The statutory auditors conducted a limited review and reported no material misstatements. Sun Drops Energia Limited acquired 62.91% of DEK and Mavericks Green Energy Limited on September 26, 2026.

attchmntText: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about  revision in time of Analysts/ Investors Earnings Conference Call. The Conference Call will now be held on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 04:30 PM.
voiceSummary: KPI Green Energy Limited has revised the timing of its conference call with investors and analysts. The call, scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, will now commence at 4:30 P.M. IST. All other details from the earlier intimation dated November 07, 2026, remain unchanged. The revised invite is hosted on the company website.
